title: Twenty-two Years and One Empty Shop
subtitle: 兴衰与变迁 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 兴衰与变迁（历史社会与文化·兴衰与变迁）
meta: 主题语境：兴衰与变迁（历史社会与文化·兴衰与变迁）　|　核心词汇：decline　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decline 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the observer ① recorded a decline that no trader in the market would have admitted, and he said the recording was the whole of the survey. The ② decline, meaning the falling off and not the fall, ran twenty-two years and stayed unremarked in the account; a decline, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ decline in that market had the same empty shop at the end of it, and the ④ decline at the end, meaning the one they left for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured twice. A decline, his clerk said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the observer said the patience is the part that fills twenty-two years.

The historian meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the decline was the whole of the century, meaning the decay and not the falling off. The ⑥ decline, meaning the decay and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody dates and nobody stops; decline, she said, is either something you record or the only word that means both a falling off and a decay. She said the decay is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ decline had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the empty shop. The ⑧ decline of the whole thing, the observer wrote in October, was one market and twenty-two years of counting; decline, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to count. She said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ decline I remember is the one at the end, which was arrested in 1984 and is still described as the slowest in the market. A ⑩ decline, the clerk said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being measured; every decline, she said, is a decay that has agreed to look like a falling off. She said the decay was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 衰退；下降（指市场里出现的那一次）
B. n. 下降（指那种减少本身，与那次跌落相对）
C. 固定搭配：record a decline 记录一次衰退
D. n. 衰退（指留到冬天才被计入的那一次）
E. n. 衰退；式微（抽象总称，指一个市场累积的衰势）
F. n. 衰退（指报告里写到、被列明的那一次）
G. n. 衰落；衰败（指一个世纪里持续的衰败）
H. n. 衰败（抽象总称，指人人断代却无人阻止的那一过程）

items.q: recorded a decline that no trader in the market would have admitted
The decline, meaning the falling off and not the fall
the decline was the whole of the century
the decline had become a line in a report
The decline of the whole thing
A decline, the clerk said in 1986

answers.why: record a decline 意为“记录一次衰退”，1958 年观察员记录了一次市场上没有一位商人肯承认的衰退。
decline 意为“下降”，指那种减少本身而不是那次跌落，它在账上延续了二十二年而无人评说。
decline 意为“衰退”，指那个市场里每一次衰退，每一次末尾都有同一间空店铺。
decline 意为“衰退”，指留到冬天才被计入的那一次，是唯一有人测算过两次的。
decline 意为“衰落、衰败”，指一个世纪里持续的衰败，史家说这场衰败就是那个世纪的全部。
decline 意为“衰败”，指人人断代却无人阻止的那一过程而不是那种减少本身，是一个世纪里人人都断代、却无人阻止的东西。
decline 意为“衰退”，指报告里写到、被列明的那一次，到 1969 年这次衰退成了报告里的一行。
decline 意为“衰退、式微”，观察员十月写道，整件事的式微是一个市场和二十二年的计算。
decline 意为“衰退”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1984 年被止住，至今仍被说成市场里最慢的一次。
decline 为抽象总称，书记员 1986 年说，一次衰退是唯一会因为被测算而变得更好的东西。
